questions.text: Какое время нужно в предложении «Dad ___ (read) the newspaper every morning»?
questions.explanation: Every morning — подсказка Present Simple (привычка); Dad = he, поэтому reads.

questions.text: Какое время нужно: «Be quiet! The baby ___ (sleep) now»?
questions.explanation: Now — подсказка Present Continuous: is sleeping.

questions.text: В каких предложениях время выбрано верно? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: We usually have lunch at two.
I am going to school every day.
She plays tennis at the moment.

questions.explanation: Usually, every day — Present Simple (I go to school every day); now, at the moment — Present Continuous (She is playing tennis at the moment).
Now — подсказка Present Continuous; they — are + глагол-ing.
Never — подсказка Present Simple; Ann = she, поэтому eats.

questions.text: Впиши правильную форму: Mum ___ (cook) dinner now.
questions.explanation: Now — Present Continuous; Mum = she: is cooking.

questions.text: Впиши правильную форму: We always ___ (help) our granny.
questions.explanation: Always — Present Simple; для we глагол без окончания: help.

pairs.right: Он играет в шахматы каждое воскресенье.

questions.explanation: Present Simple — привычка (usually, every Sunday), Present Continuous — действие сейчас (now).
«At the moment» — в данный момент, подсказка Present Continuous.
